column2: Northwest Expedition

Princess Celestia has funded an expedition into the northwestern wilderness and encouraged it to expand the bounds of pony knowledge. We have received a letter from the expedition's leader, Acorn Cap.
Northwest Expedition

In the course of our expedition into the northwestern wilderness, we came upon these curious beings for the first time: an intelligent race able to change its own form. We offered gifts to show we meant no harm, and they repaid us with silk of remarkable quality. On the whole, the contact was friendly. I have ordered the expedition to make camp nearby and to venture no further into the lands of other races, lest we give offence to our hosts. I have now sent a letter to Canterlot, asking that Her Highness's government provide the funds and supplies for a fort to be raised here, so that later explorers and merchants may be provisioned. - From the diary of Acorn Cap
Await further reports.
Gemstone Rush

In Rockville the land is barren, yet among the surrounding hills lie great rock farms for refinement that yield minerals of high quality. After the gemstone rush, ponies flocked here in great numbers, raising an unassuming village into a centre of mining and mineral processing.
The Frontier Town

Appleloosa is a young town built by pony settlers. It is ringed by countless apple orchards that produce the town's famous export: apple pie. It should come as no surprise that the overwhelming majority of its settlers belong to the far-flung Apple family.
The Old Frontier

When ponies first began to settle the lands where the buffalo were few, in the tenth century, they raised Fort Dodge to guard the thoroughfare into the Mild West. Before long a frontier settlement sprang up nearby to shelter the travellers and adventurers who passed this way. By the time it was joined by rail to the rest of Equestria, it had grown into a prosperous town called Dodge City.
The Pride of the South

Like many settlements in the south of Equestria, Hoofington began as a small fort raised by pony settlers from the north. Built upon an island in the river, it was easily held against buffalo raiders and monsters alike. The horseshoe shape of the island gave the settlement that grew up around the fort its name. After peace was made with the natives, resolute settlers rebuilt Hoofington from the ruins and made of it a city of modern design. Within only a few years this town, far younger than Dodge City, could match it in size. It is a symbol of pony diligence and a shining example of what ponies can achieve through cooperation in the span of a few short decades.
To the Southern Sea!

The phrase 'until the southern sea' is often invoked in Canterlot to justify the settlement of ponies in the south and the role of Canterlot's government in it. In short, Equestria's interest lies in bringing the southern stretch of Equus's coastline fully under its control, joining the nation's west coast to its south coast without a break. Driven by economic need and political pressure, great numbers of ponies came to settle and break the land at the continent's southernmost reaches, and in doing so clashed again and again with the local buffalo tribes.
Southwest Privy Council Administrative Committee

All in all, we have done what we could to steady the bleeding in the south. But Her Highness is deeply displeased that her government did not intervene in time to mediate between the settlers' militias and the local buffalo tribes. And so the SPCAC is founded: Canterlot has resolved to dissolve the local autonomous governments and to send a governor to lead a committee holding full legislative authority over the affairs of the Southwest.
War for the Southern Sea
The One Queen Of The Changeling Lands

After a series of great conflicts in recent years, our hive has taken the leading position in the Union, and the other renowned hives, willingly or by force, have submitted to the decrees of our hive. For the first time in history, the hives stand united under a single government. It is time for a coronation: to proclaim our queen the One Queen Of The Changeling Lands, with authority above that of any hive's mistress!
